purpose: Scheduled weekly summary of enquiry volume, source pages, classification mix, appointments booked and follow-up response times, emailed to the business owner.
permissionsRequired: Read-only access to the tenant's leads and appointments

testCases.description: Run for a week with seeded test data
testCases.expectedOutcome: Counts match a direct SQL query on the same data

testCases.description: Run for a week with no leads
testCases.expectedOutcome: Report sent with zeros; no errors

knownLimitations: Contract only: n8n blueprint JSON not yet built and exported (Phase B).
No conversion-to-enrolment metric unless staff update lead status.
rollbackApproach: Deactivate the scheduled workflow; no data is modified by this module.
